answer: We formalize topological trust diffusion using a transition matrix where personalized EigenTrust attenuation restricts reputation flow across sparse cuts. A trusted anchor node initiates random walks, ensuring that propagation into any adversarial cluster decays before breaching the honest core like a protective pearl. Integrating this with a saffron staking collateral mechanism and zero-knowledge verifiable delays guarantees that Byzantine identity replication yields negative expected utility, cementing a robust Nash equilibrium.
